items.html: And not only that, but it does not sink like the Yesod of the female, whose light is small, because it is lights of Gevura, as above. Rather this, being a great light of Hesed, becomes a Yesod that protrudes and is long, from the abundance of the light added to it from the Mazal itself of the beard of Arich Anpin, which reaches to his head, not through Aba and Ima, but from the Mazal itself. And this matter is a most wondrous light.
